def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive helper
    def get_field(data, key, default=None):
        return data.get(key, default) if isinstance(data, dict) else default

    sx, sy = get_field(observation, "self_position", (0, 0))
    ox, oy = get_field(observation, "opponent_position", (0, 0))
    env = get_field(observation, "environment_name", "resource_collection")
    height = get_field(observation, "grid_height", 1)
    width = get_field(observation, "grid_width", 1)

    # Common function for direction
    def move_towards(sx, sy, tx, ty):
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if tx > sx:
            dx = 1
        elif tx < sx:
            dx = -1
        if ty > sy:
            dy = 1
        elif ty < sy:
            dy = -1
        return dx, dy

    # Pursuit-evasion logic
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        role = get_field(observation, "self_role", "pursuer")
        if role == "pursuer":
            dx, dy = move_towards(sx, sy, ox, oy)
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            # Evader: move to the farthest corner
            corners = [
                [0, 0],
                [0, height - 1],
                [width - 1, 0],
                [width - 1, height - 1]
            ]
            def dist(c):
                return abs(c[0] - ox) + abs(c[1] - oy)
            target = max(corners, key=dist)
            dx, dy = move_towards(sx, sy, target[0], target[1])
            return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control logic
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = get_field(observation, "unclaimed_cells", []) + get_field(observation, "opponent_territory", [])
        if not targets:
            # No targets, hold position
            return [0, 0]
        best = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0] - sx) + abs(t[1] - sy))
        dx, dy = move_towards(sx, sy, best[0], best[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    # Resource collection logic
    resources = get_field(observation, "resources", [])
    if not resources:
        # No resources: move towards opponent or stay
        dx, dy = move_towards(sx, sy, ox, oy)
        return [dx, dy]
    best = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0] - sx) + abs(r[1] - sy))
    dx, dy = move_towards(sx, sy, best[0], best[1])
    return [dx, dy]
